decision.summary: One pinned host tool, one exact-index isolated driver and reuse of cache/process/hook/CI/doctor is appropriate. Do not add a parallel Actions grammar, Go build, Docker linter or remote lint Action.
required_revisions: Separate real parent-index capture from isolated child Git environment.
Prove exact-version local metadata absence/deletion behavior; do not assume the tool fails closed.
Omit the environment.lock reference-only edit; narrow provenance invariance claims.
decision.preparation_gate: Official exact host archives, executable/notices identities and actual version observation are not sealed in this reviewed proposal. Root has separately authorized preparation, whose future results are not admitted here.
decision.next_step: Root may authorize preparation/tests-first implementation with these acceptance conditions. Final code, real whole RED/GREEN, full hooks and independent review remain required.

design_strengths: Keep targeted runner.temp regression and pin/required-results/identity/permissions/shell tests. DSL lint supplements different existing contracts.

Use official exact asset lock and existing bounded content-addressed cache; no guessed latest/version/hash or runtime download wrapper. All normal lint/doctor/hook paths offline-verify an owned exact executable and fail actionable if missing.

Read complete NUL index mode/OID/stage/path records, reject unmerged entries, use staged lock/config and actual blobs, and re-read the same full index after execution. Do not depend on pre-commit stash or TDD fallback.
External temp root with relative paths and explicit complete workflow argv is the right boundary. Include all indexed action.yml/action.yaml and reusable workflows; never read a good unstaged copy.
Explicit -shellcheck= and -pyflakes= avoid analyzer discovery changing DSL results. Existing shell analysis remains separate.
One serial always-run hook with no filename subset and one step in existing commit-style job avoids a second graph. Preserve required jobs, events, permissions and identity/upload adjacency.
Bounded process.run captures raw, actual exit and timeout/withdrawal receipt. Missing tool, zero workflows, launch failures and nonzero findings cannot pass.
Use real pinned actionlint on retained bad workflow for behavioral RED, then same module and fixed full closure for GREEN; setup/missing-tool failures are separate.

implementation_gates.issue: Temp cwd alone does not isolate nested Git/project discovery if a hook exports GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE or config redirection.
implementation_gates.source_basis: scripts/ci/tdd_gate.py:environment and tools/configure/configure.py:dependency_identity already clear git rev-parse --local-env-vars for nested execution. tools/dev/process.py:execution_environment only normalizes budgets, not Git selectors.
implementation_gates.minimum: Capture and re-read the actual parent commit index, honoring a legitimate inherited GIT_INDEX_FILE. Only the isolated child gets cleaned local repository/worktree/index/config selector variables. Verify original environment is unmodified and tool discovery stays within the staged temp project. Do not clear the intended parent selector before index capture.
implementation_gates.real_tests: Real hook-selected alternate index; bad actual-index metadata plus good worktree/other index rejects. Child lookup must not reach original checkout/config; caller index/worktree unchanged.
implementation_gates.scope: Small reuse of existing environment-boundary pattern, not a general sandbox framework.

implementation_gates.issue: Copying all indexed metadata does not prove a missing/deleted local reference is fatal. The proposal promises this but delegates resolution to an unexecuted tool. Some tool behavior could skip unknown local action metadata; this review does not assert that as a proven actionlint defect.
implementation_gates.minimum: After selecting/verifying exact tool bytes, execute missing/deleted local action and reusable workflow probes plus wrong input/type/output/required-input checks. If upstream skips absence, add only a bounded direct-local-reference presence/type/containment check using reviewed YAML handling, or explicitly narrow the guarantee. Do not grow an Actions expression parser.
implementation_gates.real_tests: Bad staged local metadata with good unstaged copy rejects; staged deletion cannot fall back; good staged/bad unstaged passes input lint while preserving both. Verify isolated-root resolution.
implementation_gates.interpreter_dependency: If Python YAML handling is needed, declare it for the hook interpreter. language:python creates a separate pre-commit environment; PyYAML is not automatically present just because .venv/workflow tests have it. The existing PyYAML6.0.3 pin is in dependencies/workflow-tools.txt; no new version authority is needed.
implementation_gates.limit: Metadata inputs/outputs presence does not imply arbitrary composite script/JS/Docker validation or remote action/service availability.

implementation_gates.minimum: Seal exact official release/tag origin, normalized supported host, URL/archive size/SHA, safe bounded member inventory, extracted executable size/SHA, notice identities and actual expected -version output. Verify binary bytes before executing it; do not claim unperformed signatures.
implementation_gates.hosts: Linux x86_64 is immediate CI scope. Review official macOS x86_64/arm64 and Windows x86_64 assets before mandatory local hook portability is claimed; unknown host fails, no source-build/skip fallback.
implementation_gates.tests: Real tiny local archives for unsafe/duplicate/symlink members, extraction bound, corrupt cache, bad binary, existing-prefix/idempotence and offline-missing failures. These are installer tests; the actual selected binary must supply DSL behavior evidence.
implementation_gates.not_inherited: Author communicated that separate Root-authorized preparation is underway. No resulting sealed packet was read/admitted in this plan review.

environment_lock_recommendation.decision: Remove dependencies/environment.lock.json reference-only modification from the implementation window.
environment_lock_recommendation.authority: One dependencies/actionlint.lock.json directly shared by preparation, verifier, driver and workflows doctor is enough. An extra workflow_tools reference adds no enforcement.
actual_source_facts: tools/dev/provenance.py:56 observes every dependencies/*.lock.json as an input; :78-81 separately uses the whole environment.lock as the environment identity.
tools/dev/qualification.py:147-159 records file_identity(environment), not a subset of its keys.
cmake/package/package_source_sdk.py:45,51-52 includes dependencies and requires environment.lock in SDK payload.
tools/evidence/recipe.py:validate/verify/emit binds build-recipe lock, Python requirements and emitted Dockerfile; it does not require a workflow_tools environment reference.
environment_lock_recommendation.effect: Avoid gratuitously changing environment/SDK identities. Even an independent new actionlint.lock is already observed by the existing provenance glob, and the repository/source identity necessarily changes. Therefore do not promise the full provenance tuple stays byte-identical.
environment_lock_recommendation.precise_preservation: Keep actual compiler/OCI identities, build-recipe lock, requirements and Dockerfile unchanged. Host lint executable need not become firmware/runtime/installed-SDK/qualified-OCI requirement. Inert lock metadata may still appear in source SDK and observed input lists under current generic policies.
environment_lock_recommendation.do_not_hide: No provenance-selection rewrite or historical identity update merely to conceal the new source metadata.

implementation_details_to_keep_simple.detail: Do not reuse style_gate.staged_files(), which returns the index delta. Fetch captured OIDs, not working paths. Define digest over complete semantic records and reject unmerged entries; verify exact same records after tool execution.

Materialize regular workflow/config/action files without overwrite. Reject unsafe paths, symlink/gitlink metadata and host path aliases/case collisions that cannot be represented. Use only minimal temp Git metadata if the selected tool actually needs it; prove project discovery with exact version rather than assume it.

Only staged config may affect results. Explicit selection, no ambient/worktree config and no blanket ignore/debt suppression. Reject or define a reviewed deterministic rule if both actionlint.yaml and actionlint.yml are staged.

Reuse the cache/extraction approach, not install_ccache verbatim: current function requires a new directory and is not an existing-prefix verifier. Separate prepare/fetch from offline verify; publish binary/notices/receipt without overwriting unrelated .venv files and do not accept partial installation after interruption.

Add an early workflows branch like existing docs. Merely adding a choice would still check workspace SDK/cmake/ninja/compilers and miss the target dictionary entry. workflows doctor should need only relevant runtime/tool verification.

Resolve owned executable explicitly, not PATH. Keep the snapshot driver stdlib-only if possible; any YAML helper must use declared existing pinned dependency. No verification path calls fetch. Existing dev installer --skip-hooks and hook migration semantics remain intact.

Execute same driver after preparation in commit-style. Preserve30 job definitions/needs/events/permission semantics. Add lint report/raw/attempt receipts to both identity and upload; preserve original style artifacts and identity-before-upload adjacency.

Use a fixed owned raw/report prefix or reject aliases against selected source/lock/config/binary. Keep original failed attempts and actual exit status. A good filename, version string or receipt boolean never substitutes executable/input identity.

actionlint is workflow DSL/selected metadata validation. It is not shell runtime, remote runner admission, actual permission enforcement, SDK delivery, offline reproducibility, HIL or product release qualification.

required_actual_exit_evidence: Pinned real tool + preserved64023931 bad workflow + local closure: actual nonzero runner.temp job.env diagnostic. Same test module against0c962200 fix and all11 current workflows: actual0 without ignore/debt. Valid step-level runner.temp still passes.

Real staged/worktree disagreement for workflows/reusable/actions/config, referenced metadata deletion, additions/renames/deletions/yml+yaml/spaces, unmerged/zero/unavailable blob, staged new lock with old binary, index mutation and timeout/nonzero propagation.
Real hook environment with intended alternate parent index, sanitized isolated child, ambient config and original checkout unable to influence staged input.
Complete owned installer/dependency/doctor/workflow modules and ordinary full-index hooks, no filters/skips. First setup/model/tool-missing failures classified separately from real DSL RED.
If full lint reveals other actual defects, preserve them and request exact additional minimal scope rather than silently modifying all workflows or creating a debt baseline.

current_static_observations.meaning: Counts are statically parsed YAML definitions, not successful GitHub jobs. No full actionlint pass is claimed.

coordination: Root/author received Git-env and local-metadata concerns. Author accepted them as implementation gates and agreed to omit environment reference; old proposal was not modified and this statement is not code/test evidence.
